subject.instructions: Which school subject or IT module is the test in `first_page_text` for? Pick the subject being taught, not the language the test is written in: most tests are written in French.

criteria.subjects/Anglais: Anglais: English language test (English texts, grammar, vocabulary, writing). Headers or grading grids can be in French. A test titled 'English Test' is Anglais even when the topic is IT (websites, networks, emails)
criteria.subjects/Maths: Mathématiques (CBE Math, mathématiques fondamentales, mathématiques renforcées): equations, calculations, geometry, functions, exercises with numbers
criteria.subjects/Allemand: Allemand: German language test (German words or texts, Wortschatztest, Deutsch). Vocabulary tests list French words to translate into German. German headers like Name + Vorname, Klasse, Datum, Grammatik, Hören, Insgesamt mean Allemand, even when the class code is XMPT or TASV
criteria.subjects/Français: Français: French language itself: grammar, spelling, conjugation, prefixes and suffixes, literature. Not every test written in French is a French test
criteria.subjects/Histoire: Histoire et institutions politiques: historical events (revolutions, world wars, colonisation), analysis of a historical source, letter, map or image. Written in French
criteria.subjects/Eco&Droit: Économie et droit (ECDR), maturity classes like XMPT: law (droit des obligations, droit pénal, droit commercial), economics
criteria.subjects/ECG: Culture générale (ECG, CG), apprentice classes like DEVA: society, apprenticeship contract, bank and post, media and press, analysis of a poster or advert, oral argumentation, basic economics. Written in French
criteria.OTHER: None of the subjects or modules above
